description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class named ContentImageController that manages content images within an admin interface. It provides endpoints for viewing, adding, removing, and paginating images associated with merchant stores, specifically for content management in a web application.

classes.name: ContentImageController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller managing static content images for an admin panel, including listing, uploading, and deleting images for merchant stores.

methods.name: displayFileBrowser
methods.description: Returns the view for the file browser used in the JavaScript content editor.

methods.name: getContentImages
methods.description: Returns the view for displaying content images for a merchant store.

methods.name: pageImages
methods.description: Handles AJAX POST requests to retrieve a paginated list of image file names, returning JSON data.

methods.name: displayContentImagesCreate
methods.description: Returns the view to allow admins to create/upload new content images.

methods.name: saveContentImages
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save/upload new content images for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeImage
methods.description: Removes a specified image from the content storage.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu attributes in the model for view rendering.
